messages.subject: a mixture-model expression in Stan
parts:
Hi all. I was corresponding with someone who was trying to use Stan for models with discrete parameters, using the mixture model formulation as explained in the manual. He felt that the log-probability specification was hard for users in his subfield to understand. This made me think, maybe we could add a new distribution called finite_mixture or something like that, where the arguments are the probabilities and the mixture distributions. I’m not quite sure how this would be done—to do it in sufficient generality to be useful might end up being even more complicated to use—but I just wanted to throw this idea out there.
A
